summary: Completed P0 regression testing for templates + output channels (backend and frontend). Backend critical scenarios passed (HTML upload/use, sanitization, set-default scope uniqueness, outbound missing_variables contract). Frontend confirmed key flows but found QuickPrint blocking issue when default template contains unresolved placeholders.

ui_bugs.issue: When default template is incomplete (unresolved placeholder), preview iframe never renders and quick actions remain blocked by generic error. User can get stuck on current default template path.
Invoice group UI can show more than one default badge at once (system + tenant), which conflicts with expected single-active-default mental model for managers.

integration_issues.flow: QuickPrint WhatsApp/PDF/Print with incomplete default template
integration_issues.issue: Output actions remain visible (correct), but generation fails before preview and WhatsApp open is blocked due template generation error instead of clean missing_variables guidance.

issues: Error messaging in failure state is generic and does not clearly expose unresolved template variables for manager action

action_items: In QuickPrint, provide deterministic recovery path when default template is incomplete (auto-select next valid template OR block with explicit missing_variables and selector guidance).
Align TemplatesManager default badge display with scope semantics so manager sees one effective default per selected tenant/type/locale.
Add explicit UI assertion path for WhatsApp preconditions: differentiate missing phone vs missing template variables vs template load failure.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend sanitizer and resolver contract are solid for this scope: upload sanitization strips script/event handlers and /use returns explicit_document_template reason with content.
set-default backend enforcement for default+invoice+ar-SA scope is correct in API-level tests; observed ambiguity is mainly UI representation in mixed system/tenant list.
QuickPrint currently couples output actions to successful preview generation; with incomplete default templates this degrades to generic generation error and weak guidance UX.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (core requested flows mostly pass; QuickPrint incomplete-default flow remains problematic)

seed_data_creation: Created UI test templates: ITER286_UI_SAFE, ITER286_UI_MAL, ITER286_UI_GUARD (and temporary backend upload test templates archived during backend tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: DocumentPrint validated with only 3 output buttons (WhatsApp/PDF/Print) and no duplicate output controls in preview toolbar. WhatsApp secondary preview modal did not appear (as required). QuickPrint error state is reproducible when selected/default template is incomplete (REQUIRED_BLOCKER).
rca of the issue: RCA: If default/selected QuickPrint template contains unresolved placeholders, generateHtml path fails early (template guard) and quick-print-preview iframe is never rendered. Actions remain present but effectively blocked by generic error text, causing manager-facing flow break. This is not a backend resolver/sanitizer failure; it is a frontend flow/UX handling gap around incomplete template defaults.
